demo.title: Settings
demo.resetHint: Brightness, volume and quality go back to their defaults. The nickname stays.

gallery.title: AUI gallery
gallery.logTitle: Everything the pages emitted, newest first
gallery.logEmpty: Nothing logged yet. Use the other pages or run the tests.

home.blurb: Every page on the left is a nested view with its own markup, stylesheet and code. This one shows an inline component, a bound style value and a timer; the others cover the rest. Pick a page or start the tour.

texts.title: Text, four ways
texts.wrap: This paragraph wraps because it has wrap="true" and a max-width. It was measured over every language so the tallest translation fits; max-lines cuts it off with an ellipsis when a runtime string is longer.
texts.runtimeLabel: A runtime string with a dynamic font fallback

lists.title: Repeats
lists.empty: The board is empty. Add a player.

layout.title: Flex playground
layout.hint: The stage's direction, justify, align, wrap, gap and padding are bound style values; the solver runs again in Udon after every change.

states.title: Styles
states.hint: Hover, press and hold each button; their states come from the theme, the shared sheet and this view's style block. Below, a class binding, an added class, three bound style values and two utilities restyle a card through the same cascade.

theme.title: Re-theme in-world
theme.hint: Each preset writes the theme's :root variables with SetStyleVariable. With the switch on it goes through the language service to every view in the world; off, only this page changes.

runtime.title: Created at runtime
runtime.sureHint: Every line goes back to the pool. Click outside to keep them.

langdemo.title: Languages
langdemo.hint: The service starts from the client language, remembers a pick in PlayerData, and repaints every view. Anything with a key follows; runtime strings stay as they are.
langdemo.sample: The active language is {native} ({code}); this world ships {total} of them.
